summary.result: The characteristics of changes in paddy rice yield according to NDVI and other meteorological elements were well reflected by the KRPM.
summary.background: In the case of Korea where the staple food is rice, the rice yield prediction is regarded as a very important task to cope with unstable food supply at a national level.
summary.method: In this study, Korean paddy Rice yield Prediction Model (KRPM) developed to predict the paddy rice yield using meteorological element and MODIS NDVI.
